name: Admin Idle Timeout
description: Limita a 10 minutos el tiempo de inactividad de las sesiones administrativas.

checks.description: admintimeout debe ser menor o igual a 10 minutos

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system global
  set admintimeout 10
end

name: Disable Insecure Management Protocols
description: Evita HTTP y Telnet en las interfaces del dispositivo.

checks.description: HTTP y Telnet no deben estar en allowaccess

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system interface
  edit "<interface_name>"
    unselect allowaccess http telnet
  next
end

name: Disable HTTP Redirection
description: Deshabilita la redirección automática de HTTP a HTTPS.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system global
  set admin-https-redirect disable
end

name: Change Default Admin Username
description: La cuenta administrativa predeterminada admin debe estar deshabilitada.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system admin
  edit "admin"
    set status disable
  next
end

name: Enable Private Data Encryption
description: Activa el cifrado de datos privados almacenados en la configuración.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system global
  set private-data-encryption enable
end

name: Enforce Strong Cryptography
description: Fuerza el uso de criptografía fuerte en el sistema.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system global
  set strong-crypto enable
end

name: Disable Static Key Ciphers
description: Deshabilita cifrados SSL/TLS con claves estáticas.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system global
  set ssl-static-key-ciphers disable
end

name: Disable USB Auto-Installation
description: Deshabilita la instalación automática de firmware y configuración desde USB.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system auto-install
  set auto-install-config disable
  set auto-install-image disable
end

name: Enforce PBKDF2 Password Hashing
description: Detecta hashes administrativos heredados SHA256 con prefijo SH2.

checks.description: La contraseña no debe usar el formato heredado SH2

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system admin
  edit "<admin_user>"
    set password <new_password>
  next
end

name: Firewall Session Handling
description: Verifica que firewall-session-dirty use un valor soportado por FortiOS.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system settings
  set firewall-session-dirty check-all
end

name: Restrict All Objects in Security Policies
description: Evita políticas accept activas con all como origen y destino simultáneamente.

checks.description: Origen y destino no deben ser all al mismo tiempo

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config firewall policy
  edit <policy_id>
    set srcaddr <specific_addr_group>
    set dstaddr <specific_addr_group>
  next
end

name: Enable match-vip on Deny Policies
description: Activa match-vip en políticas de denegación.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config firewall policy
  edit <policy_id>
    set match-vip enable
  next
end

name: Configure DoS Security Policies
description: Requiere al menos una política DoS configurada.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config firewall DoS-policy
  edit 1
    set interface <interface_name>
  next
end

name: Restrict Management via Local-In Policies
description: Requiere políticas local-in explícitas para proteger el plano de control.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config firewall local-in-policy
  edit 1
    set action accept
  next
end

name: Enforce 2FA for SSL VPN Users
description: Exige doble factor en todas las cuentas locales evaluadas.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config user local
  edit <username>
    set two-factor fortitoken
  next
end

name: Enforce TLS 1.2+ for SSL VPN
description: Impide el uso de versiones obsoletas de TLS en SSL-VPN.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config vpn ssl settings
  set ssl-min-proto-version tls1-2
end

name: Secure IPsec Phase 1 Proposals
description: Excluye DES, 3DES y MD5 de las propuestas IPsec de fase 1.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config vpn ipsec phase1-interface
  edit <tunnel_name>
    set proposal aes256-sha256 aes128-sha256
  next
end

name: HA Monitored Interfaces Configured
description: Exige interfaces monitoreadas cuando el modo HA no es standalone.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system ha
  set monitor "port1" "port2"
end

name: Enforce Botnet Blocking in DNS Filter
description: Activa el bloqueo de Botnet C&C en todos los perfiles DNS Filter.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config dnsfilter profile
  edit <profile_name>
    set block-botnet-connections enable
  next
end

name: Replace Default Admin Certificate
description: Evita el certificado auto-firmado Fortinet_Factory en la administración.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system global
  set admin-server-cert <custom_ca_signed_cert>
end

name: Enable Centralized Remote Logging
description: Exige el envío de logs a FortiAnalyzer habilitado.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config log fortianalyzer setting
  set status enable
  set server <FAZ_IP>
end

name: Configure AntiVirus Scanning
description: Requiere perfiles Antivirus con escaneo HTTP activo.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config antivirus profile
  edit <profile_name>
    config http
      set options scan
    end
  next
end

name: Enforce NTP Synchronization
description: Habilita la sincronización NTP y exige servidores definidos.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system ntp
  set ntpsync enable
end

name: Disable Unused Physical Interfaces
description: Detecta interfaces sin IP que permanecen administrativamente activas.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system interface
  edit <interface_name>
    set status down
  next
end

name: Configure SD-WAN Health Checks
description: Requiere health checks cuando SD-WAN está habilitado.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config system sdwan
  config health-check
    edit "Internet_Check"
      set server "1.1.1.1"
    next
  end
end

name: Enforce Deep SSL Inspection
description: Exige inspección profunda en políticas accept activas.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config firewall policy
  edit <policy_id>
    set ssl-ssh-profile "deep-inspection"
  next
end

name: Enable Application Control Profile
description: Exige Application Control en políticas accept activas.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config firewall policy
  edit <policy_id>
    set application-list "default"
  next
end

name: Enable Intrusion Prevention System
description: Exige sensor IPS en políticas accept activas.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config firewall policy
  edit <policy_id>
    set ips-sensor "default"
  next
end

name: Block QUIC Protocol
description: Requiere perfiles de Application Control configurados para bloquear QUIC.

rule_spec.remediation_cmd:
config application list
  edit "default"
    config entries
      edit 1
        set application 31077
        set action block
      next
    end
  next
end
